QuestInfo.name: Welcome, Now Scram
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Lucas, the town chief of Amherst.
QuestInfo.1: Lucas encourages you to head off of Maple Island to get more powerful. Take the ticket he gave you to Southperry and give it to #bVasily#k.\r\n\r\n#b#eTip:#n If you lose the ticket, forfeit the quest and accept it again.#k
QuestInfo.2: Lucas encouraged you to leave Maple Island to get more powerful. You took the ticket he gave you to Vasily, the captain at Southperry, who gave you permission to board the Sangri-La.\r\n
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 150
Can proceed to Not Quite Adventure Time

0.0: Let me officially welcome you to Amherst, but I'm afraid you can't stay here.  \r\n#L0##bI can't?#l\n#k
0.1: Unfortunately not. I mean, it's a great town and the mushroom-flavored coffee is amazing, but it's not for you. \r\n#L0##bHow come?#l\n#k
0.2: Amherst's for old folks, like me. You have your whole life ahead of you. You have battles to fight, areas to explore, new people to meet, new foods to taste!\r\n#L0##bCan't I fight, explore, and meet new people here?#l\n#k
0.3: All we've got here are Orange Mushrooms and some pigs. You can't get to Lv. 250 fighting those.\r\n#L0##bI can't?#l\n#k
0.4: Not unless you want to slay #b3,000,000,000#k of them...\r\n#L0##bI don't get it.#l\n#k
0.5: You get #bless EXP for hunting weaker monsters#k. Eventually, when you reach a certain level, you won't get any EXP at all.\r\n#L0##bLeveling sound difficult.#l\n#k
0.6: It doesn't have to be. The trick is to fight monsters near your level.\r\n#L0##bAnd I can't do that if I stay on Maple Island. I think I get it now.#l\n#k
0.7: Good, then let me give you this #bticket#k so you can take a one-way trip off this island and on to adventure!

yes.0: Hand this ticket over to #bVasily#k at the #bSouthperry#k harbor. He'll ferry you over to Victoria Island and your real adventure can begin.
yes.1: Don't look so sad. I was kidding about the one-way thing. You can always come back to visit me and Mai.

no.0: Don't tell me you really plan to hunt #b3,000,000,000 Orange Mushrooms#k...

1.0: Ah, the new Explorer. You'll need a ticket to board. Rules are rules, after all.
